How stilled is the mind!
Truly, the Buddha's bidding is done!
So freed! So thoroughly freed am I!
How exquisite is Unbinding!
Praise to the Dhamma!
Praise to the Saṅgha!
Oh, how quiet!
No more births!
Let us go to the forest!
Listen to the wise!
Abandon all craving!
Strive relentlessly!
Rejoice in the Dhamma!
Be alert, monks!
See the Truth!
Stay concentrated!
Do not be heedless!
What a great king!
How peaceful is this night!
Look at the stars!
Sikhī has spoken!
Channa is released!
Jayasena is stilled!
Bhūmija is calmed!
Cundaka is quiet!
Bhaggas are prosperous!
Nibbuti is attained!
This is the ultimate goal!
May you be happy!
